# Case Study: Biomarker Stratification and Dysbiosis in Atopic Dermatitis

Atopic Dermatitis (AD) involves epidermal barrier disruption, Type 2 immune polarization (IL-4/IL-13), and cutaneous *Staphylococcus aureus* colonization. This case study demonstrates an end-to-end analytical workflow combining transcriptomics, serum biomarkers, and microbial networks.

## Clinical Background

Patients present with varying disease severity evaluated by the SCORAD (Scoring Atopic Dermatitis) index. Transcriptomic profiling of lesional skin demonstrates upregulation of *IL13*, *IL4R*, *CCL18*, and *S100A7*, with concurrent downregulation of structural barrier genes *FLG* and *LOR*.

## Step 1: Transcriptomic Signature (Volcano Plot)

```{r ad-volcano, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=5.0}
library(cliomicplot)

set.seed(101)
n_genes <- 800
ad_volc_df <- data.frame(
  Gene   = paste0("Gene_", 1:n_genes),
  log2FC = rnorm(n_genes, 0, 1.3),
  pValue = runif(n_genes, 0, 1)^3
)

# Insert defined AD biomarkers
key_markers <- c("IL13", "IL4R", "CCL18", "S100A7", "FLG", "LOR")
ad_volc_df$log2FC[1:6] <- c(3.4, 2.9, 3.8, 4.2, -3.9, -3.2)
ad_volc_df$pValue[1:6] <- c(1e-12, 1e-9, 1e-11, 1e-15, 1e-14, 1e-10)
ad_volc_df$Gene[1:6]   <- key_markers

p_volc <- cliplot(
  pValue ~ log2FC,
  data   = ad_volc_df,
  type   = type_volcano(
    fc_cutoff   = 1.5,
    pval_cutoff = 0.01,
    label_genes = key_markers
  ),
  preset = "nature",
  title  = "Transcriptomic Signature: AD Lesional vs Healthy Controls"
)
p_volc
```

## Step 2: Serum Biomarker Stratification Across Severity Tiers

Serum IL-13 and CCL17 levels correlate with objective SCORAD tiers:

```{r ad-scorad-box, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4.8}
set.seed(42)
scorad_df <- data.frame(
  Severity = factor(rep(c("Mild (SCORAD < 25)", "Moderate (25-50)", "Severe (> 50)"), each = 30),
                    levels = c("Mild (SCORAD < 25)", "Moderate (25-50)", "Severe (> 50)")),
  CCL17    = c(rnorm(30, 250, 45), rnorm(30, 680, 120), rnorm(30, 1850, 310))
)

p_box <- cliplot(
  CCL17 ~ Severity,
  data   = scorad_df,
  type   = "boxplot",
  preset = "nature",
  title  = "Serum CCL17 Levels Stratified by Objective SCORAD Tiers"
)
p_box
```

## Step 3: Cutaneous Dysbiosis and Environmental Coupling

Coupling cutaneous microbial abundance with transepidermal water loss (TEWL), SCORAD, and environmental humidity:

```{r ad-coupled-network, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=8.5}
p_env <- cliplot_env_network(
  title              = "Cutaneous Microbiome Coupling with Biophysical Barrier and Clinical Drivers",
  show_values        = TRUE,
  show_domain_labels = TRUE,
  compact            = TRUE,
  preset             = "clinical",
  scifig             = TRUE
)
p_env
```
